prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic test concept in an underground book-conservation lab after a sprinkler alarm. Show one unmistakably adult woman whose facial and general appearance echoes the attached portrait as the dominant figure, with long deep-brown wavy hair, a centered part, softly oval face, dark-brown eyes, and calm focus. She steadies a waterlogged illuminated folio on a transparent suction table positioned beside her while emergency humidity strips curl and amber alarm light ripples across shallow puddles. Inside a subterranean conservation aisle of wet concrete, stainless benches, translucent drying racks, plastic-draped shelving, rescue crates, and dehumidifier hoses, a slate-blue button-front blouse with a clean pointed neckline and full sleeves is tucked clearly into the trouser waistband and pairs with cropped wide-leg culottes. One waistband feeds a central trouser rise above a clearly readable bifurcated trouser structure. A visible crotch or inseam divides the lower garment into distinct left and right trouser legs. Two wide legs move independently in the stride, with separate inner and outer edges. Two separate hems end around the calves, one clear hem opening for each wide trouser leg. A continuous midi-skirt panel does not substitute for two legs, pleat shadow does not count as an inseam, and full-length palazzo hems cannot substitute for the cropped variant. Fine matte crepe catches cool utility highlights through soft gravity-led folds and a dry low-sheen surface. Keep the transparent table, separated arms, hands, and folio beside her silhouette, leaving blouse buttons, waistband, rise, crotch, inseam, both legs, and both hems directly visible during a slight natural stride. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Frame her eye-level from hair to shoes with small margins, realistic skin and wet-paper texture, cool fluorescent light, raking amber alarm reflections, and restrained documentary depth.
